title: TrustedIssuerStore: expired CA cert still used after expiry
description: trusted_issuer_store.rs checks leaf.validity().is_valid() but never checks the CA cert validity period at startup or per-connection. An expired CA continues authenticating new leaf certs. issuer_from_pem should check ca_cert.validity().is_valid() and return Err (or at least warn) if the CA has expired.
